title: The aixmibd daemon must be disabled on AIX.
check_content:
From the command prompt, execute the following command: 
# grep "^start[[:blank:]]/usr/sbin/aixmibd" /etc/rc.tcpip

If there is any output from the command, this is a finding.
fixtext:
In "/etc/rc.tcpip", comment out the "aixmibd" entry by running command: 
# chrctcp -d aixmibd
VulnDiscussion:
The aixmibd daemon is a dpi2 sub-agent which manages a number of MIB variables. 

To prevent attacks this daemon should not be enabled unless there is no alternative.
